profile.name: Maya Demo Student
goals: choose a realistic AI portfolio project

recommendation.title: Career readiness copilot for scholarship and internship prep
recommendation.portfolio_artifact: A verified plan, portfolio rubric, and outreach-safe opportunity shortlist.

plan.title: Decision baseline
plan.action: Confirm the student goal, constraints, target role, and success rubric.
plan.human_gate: Student approves goals before recommendations are used.

plan.title: Skill-gap sprint
plan.action: Practice the top two missing skills with one artifact per skill.
plan.evidence: Two short artifacts and self-rating deltas.
plan.human_gate: Mentor or peer reviews evidence before the next step.

plan.title: Portfolio artifact
plan.action: Build and explain: A verified plan, portfolio rubric, and outreach-safe opportunity shortlist.
plan.evidence: Portfolio page, demo screenshot, and transparent model notes.
plan.human_gate: Student confirms no private data appears in the artifact.

plan.title: Opportunity match
plan.action: Map the artifact to internships, scholarships, clubs, or research openings.
plan.evidence: Shortlist with why-match reasoning and outreach draft.
plan.human_gate: Student approves each outreach action manually.

guardrails: Use synthetic demo personas unless a real student explicitly opts in.
Never infer protected traits or rank students by worth; score only stated goals and skills.
Show why every recommendation was made, including weak evidence and missing inputs.
Keep career actions human-approved before outreach, applications, or public portfolio changes.
Warn that the system supports decisions and does not guarantee jobs, admissions, or awards.

evidence_graph.label: Student-stated goal
evidence_graph.evidence: Profile goals, interests, constraints and skill ratings.

evidence_graph.label: Skill-gap score
evidence_graph.evidence: Required skills compared against current confidence.

evidence_graph.label: Portfolio artifact
evidence_graph.evidence: A verified plan, portfolio rubric, and outreach-safe opportunity shortlist.

evidence_graph.label: Human approval gate
evidence_graph.evidence: Student approves outreach, public claims and sensitive data use.

evidence_graph.label: Judge evidence receipt
evidence_graph.evidence: Generated experiment, readiness report and demo screenshots.

demo_claims: Turns vague student goals into an explainable decision ledger.
Produces portfolio evidence instead of only advice.
Keeps sensitive student identity and school proof out of public artifacts.
Supports responsible AI review through transparent scores, gaps, counterfactuals, and warnings.
